a.lede: Model maker commits to new framework for reporting misaligned models.
a.title: Covert uploads and megalomania: OpenAI details new "misaligned" agent incidents

b.lede: The company also disclosed previously unreported incidents in which its AI models behaved in misaligned ways, including uploading files to the internet without being asked.
b.title: OpenAI Creates a New Framework to Disclose Bad AI Behavior
